author: Thomas Klikauer
title: A Union Battle in late 2026 in Germany
content: With Germany’s export capitalism in deep crisis, German capital has gone on the attack, seeking to destroy the eight-hour workday, lower wages, and push workers ever deeper into job insecurity. German trade unions like IG Metall have vowed to resist this. Most expect a big showdown between labor and capital this coming fall and winter. [...]

title: The Shock Absorber of Democracy

title: California’s Fight to Tax the Rich—the Demand of the Hour
content: I first visited New York back in the early 1970s. A native Californian, I was astonished at the extremes of wealth and poverty in the Big Apple. title: A Spectacle Of The Macabre In New York
content: What’s unfolding in New York is a show of breath-taking degeneracy, a depraved spectacle exposing the illegitimate imperial order and the institutions on which it is built. author: Renata Wimer
title: Cuba, or the Audacity of Freedom
content: Despite centuries of colonial domination and the subsequent US blockade, Cuba has achieved great things, guided by anti-imperialism, revolutionary internationalism and solidarity among peoples. author: João Antonio Cunha
title: Meta Blocks President Lula’s Facebook Page and Campaign Ads
content: Meta disabled the Facebook page of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on Wednesday. It also restricted the ad account linked to his campaign. The platform gave no justification for the move, in its communications with Lula’s Workers’ Party. The PT and the “Brazil Ready for More” electoral coalition have demanded explanations. title: Gaza’s Horizon: Shattered Order and Regional Renewal
content: The rebellion that shattered the dawn of 7 October 2023 did more than break through the concrete Zionist walls surrounding Gaza. author: Carlos Ron
